title: Valid Parentheses
summary: Read a string of round, square and curly brackets.

contractDetails.constraints: The string has 1–10,000 characters. Each character is one of `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`, `{`, `}`.

statement: Read a string of round, square and curly brackets. Return whether every opener is closed by the matching bracket type and whether pairs nest correctly. A closing bracket must match the most recent opener that is still waiting.

examples.explanation: The inner parentheses close first, then the braces and square brackets. The last pair is independent.
The first closing brace appears while an opening parenthesis is still waiting.
The final opening brace has no partner.

constraints: The string has 1–10,000 characters. Each character is one of `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`, `{`, `}`.
hints: Conceptual: When a bracket closes, the matching opener must be the innermost one still open.
Directional: Use a stack to remember the opening brackets whose partners have not appeared.
Implementation: Push each opener. On a closer, fail if the stack is empty or its top has a different type. Require an empty stack after the scan.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space for n characters. Each opener enters the stack once, and deep nesting can fill it.
